fields.Name: IT35 - RunQuery Feature Surface
fields.Description: RunQuery feature surface server-side: ad-hoc SQL contract incl. read-only rejection of mutations, MaxRows/StartRow paging with TotalRowCount, CacheLocal CacheHit/CacheKey/ExecutionTime contract, since|sqlDate injection guard pin, ValidationFilters enforcement pins driving QueryParameterProcessor directly. QF11-QF16 add RunQuery behaviour checks; QF17 QueryEngine rows stay MJQueryEntityExtended instances after a JSON-round-tripped cache hit and after a cross-server cache-change event, and RunQuery then succeeds. Self-cleaning fixture query. Server transport (CacheHit/CacheKey stripped by the GraphQL client).
